caption: The drawing features a central oval image bordered by a decorative frame made of green leaves, pink and orange flowers, and bunches of purple grapes, with floral garlands and curving stems extending outward. Inside the oval, there is a landscape scene with a river winding through grassy green hills and past trees, fences, and houses with yellow and red roofs. In the middle ground, there are fields and a rocky hill with more buildings on top. In the background, a light blue sky appears behind clouds, out of which a set of hands emerges, holding a crown and a scepter, with radiant light depicted in yellow, orange, and red. Below the landscape, within the decorative frame, there is a scroll or ribbon with German text written in black script, bordered by blue and gold scrollwork. The colors used are predominantly green, blue, yellow, pink, and brown, with subtle shading. The entire drawing is centered on a plain beige background.
title: Zoar Decorative Painting: "This World and the Next"
